in_marathi.name: Sushilkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sushilkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Su' meaning graceful and 'Shil' meaning warrior. Sushilkumar is a name that embodies the strength and courage of a warrior. The name signifies someone who is brave, courageous and has a strong will.
